nodes.label: Original Acquisition GUI Prompt (v3)
nodes.rationale: The originating spec that acquisition/CLAUDE.md was distilled from. Its hardware figures (720p60, ~110 MB pre-roll, ~75 MB/min, ~225 MB per 3-minute trial, CRF ~18) were later corrected by HARDWARE.md's measurement of a 720x540 sensor.

nodes.label: Decoupled Capture/Encode/Display Threading Model
nodes.rationale: Image event handler not polling, bounded per-camera queue that drops and counts on overflow, separate writer thread piping to FFmpeg stdin, preview throttled to ~15 fps reading latest-frame. Recording integrity must never depend on the GUI thread or any pose component.

nodes.label: PoseProvider Protocol (stubbed only)
nodes.rationale: send_frame / get_latest_pose (non-blocking) wired into the capture path with a NullPoseProvider, so it can later be swapped for network-offload or on-device Jetson inference. TriggerService.on_pose is a no-op hook for future closed-loop use; no actual inference is implemented.

nodes.label: Paradigm Plugin Seam (PDCTParadigm only)
nodes.rationale: A Paradigm abstraction covers metadata schema, trial state machine and output naming, with exactly one concrete implementation shipped; the seam makes adding a maze paradigm a matter of writing a new class rather than touching the acquisition core.
